summary.text: Debra Davis is a Democratic member of the Maryland House of Delegates from District 28, where she has served since January 9, 2019, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Davis succeeded Sally Jameson in the seat.
For 2025-2026 she is assigned to the Environment and Transportation Committee, and she previously served on the Judiciary Committee.
She finished first in the June 23, 2026 Democratic primary for District 28's three seats, with 26.4% of the vote.
